# Phosphor icons 2.1.1

`regular.css` and `Phosphor.woff2` come from `@phosphor-icons/web@2.1.1`.
`map-pin.svg` comes from `@phosphor-icons/core@2.1.1/assets/regular/map-pin.svg`.
The original MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/web
Icon source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core

The files are served locally with TripLOG. No runtime icon CDN is required.
